fact: The UN Women and CBS assessment (fieldwork March-July 2021) says a new National Statistics Development Strategy (NSDS) is currently under development; the document gives no date for it, so the publication date is used.

The abridged National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS) 2012-2016, coordinated by the CBS with UNDP support, is presented as the finalised national strategy, its design steps ending in stakeholder approval and finalisation; it does not name an adoption date, so the document date is used.

The full Republic of Sudan National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS) 2012-2016 is published by the CBS with UNDP support; the excerpt does not state an adoption date, so the document year is used.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): NSDS 2017-2021.
